jobDescription.name: About Kranich
jobDescription.value: Kranich Software GmbH builds warehouse-management software for mid-sized retailers in Germany and Austria. We are 60 people, headquartered in Hamburg, and our engineering team has worked fully remotely since 2020.

jobDescription.name: Your mission
jobDescription.value:
• Develop and maintain Node.js and TypeScript services for stock movements, picking and shipping.
  • Design PostgreSQL schemas and write efficient queries for tables with hundreds of millions of rows.
  • Build integrations with ERP and accounting systems (SAP, DATEV) over REST and SFTP.
  • Write automated tests and take part in code reviews and our fortnightly architecture round.

jobDescription.name: Your profile
jobDescription.value:
• Must have: 1-2 years of professional experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Must have: solid SQL, ideally PostgreSQL.
  • Must have: English at B2 level or better. German is not required; the engineering team works in English.
  • Nice to have: Docker, RabbitMQ, or experience with logistics software.

jobDescription.name: Why us?
jobDescription.value:
• EUR 42,000-50,000 per year, or an equivalent contractor rate outside the EU.
  • Remote across EMEA and South Asia through our employer-of-record partner.
  • 30 days of vacation, a learning budget of EUR 1,000 and a yearly team week in Hamburg.
